other_conditions: Must be a resident of Gujarat.
Must be at least 14 years old (18 years for hazardous trades).
Must meet the minimum educational qualification specific to the trade and be at least a 5th pass-out.
Must satisfy physical fitness standards prescribed for the trade.
Must not have been engaged in any similar apprenticeship program previously.
benefits_summary: Provides a stipend ranging from ₹1500 to ₹3000 depending on trade and qualification, with training durations of 6‑36 months.
